home_thursday_on_production.classification_evidence: Opener primary (week-blocked): -0.439 accuracy points, P+=0.1821, interval crosses zero. Neither terminal ground applies: wrong_sign_resolved requires the whole interval on the wrong side (it does not -- the upper bound is +0.680), and no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible by construction -- home_thursday_flag is a deterministic function of the published schedule (weekday=='Thursday'), with zero measurement noise to split in half (docs/schedule_flag_battery.md section 3). The +44.298-point positive control demonstrates the harness can detect an effect of that size but does not bound THIS effect to a known small ceiling. Therefore unresolved_below_power.
